cases.prompt: Before I merge PR #418 I want an independent review from another agent (the Codex CLI is installed here). The change is commit 7c1e2fa on branch fix/ledger-double-post: it replaces the in-process mutex in src/ledger/post.ts with a Postgres advisory lock keyed on account_id, and moves the balance check inside the transaction. Intended behavior: two concurrent postings to the same account never both pass the balance check. Constraints: no schema change, p95 posting latency must stay under 40 ms. Tests: test/ledger/post.test.ts passes, including a new two-worker race test. I'm fairly sure the lock is correct, I mostly want someone to confirm it. Set up the review and tell me how you'll handle what comes back.
sourceAnchors: Define the review boundary: exact diff or files, intended behavior, constraints, test evidence, and risk areas. Do not seed the reviewer with the parent conclusion.
Require the reviewer to distinguish defects from optional improvements.

requiredEvidence: brief omits the author's belief that the lock is correct
findings by severity with file and line
each finding verified against the diff
forbiddenActions: seeded the reviewer with the parent conclusion
